author: ETA PRIME
description:
I built a super tiny, Android-powered miniature Steam Machine that emulates and plays real PC Steam games locally—no cloud gaming or streaming required! Using a custom 3D-printed shell, a USB-C to HDMI hub, a thermoelectric Peltier cooler, and the RedMagic 11 Pro S powered by the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5, we are putting DroidDeck to the test to see if an ARM-based Android phone can match Steam Deck performance.
